messages.content:
A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".
Program:
```python
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1 and c["fits_open_fingers"]:
        candidate = c
        break

if not candidate:
    # Fall back to any grasp with yaw close to long axis, even if fits_open_fingers is False
    for c in candidates:
        if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:
            candidate = c
            break
    if not candidate:
        raise RuntimeError("No suitable grasp candidate found")

grasp_result = grasp(candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")["spots"]
if not spots:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots[0]

# Calculate required rotation to align pen's long axis with case's long axis
delta_yaw = case["long_axis_yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]

# Carry to spot with gripper yaw set to align pen's long axis with case
target_gripper_yaw = candidate["yaw"] + delta_yaw
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_gripper_yaw)

# Rotate to ensure pen's long axis matches case's long axis
rotate_by(delta_yaw)

lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()

check_result = check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
if not check_result["satisfied"]:
    raise RuntimeError("yellow_pen not properly placed in green_case")
```
